title: There is room for you.
brief: A fictional community supper club announcement.
headline:
There is room
for you.
scene: Soft pink and bright teal blocks with one golden-yellow disc. Circular photographic cutout of three diverse adult friends laughing around an outdoor supper table on the right. Oversized black rounded italic serif on left, tiny hand-cut orange star and blue wavy ribbon. Warm candid photography, festive editorial collage with clear hierarchy.
